unit: One warm-daemon review per pinned public PR. Same eight-file hook batches, 8 s event deadline, 22 s external watchdog. PR wall time from first hook launch through final exit; initialization of persistent daemons and GitHub retrieval excluded.
method: Four sequential full-cohort three-arm rounds preselected before confirmation, shuffled PR order per seed and rotated order across all six arm permutations. TypeSafe jev-latest returned jev-1.14.0. No application result cache. Precision and recall micro-averaged against the original 52 frozen file/rule positives. Bootstrap resamples 46 PR clusters including all paired repeats, nearest-rank percentiles, 6000 draws.

variants.calibrated: Current calibrated four workers with TypeSafe caller deadline
variants.candidate: Calibrated hook with up to eight concurrent hosted TypeSafe requests and rule loading deferred to the checking process

frozenResponseAudit.method: Intercept fetch without network on each actual implementation, compare SHA-256 of the exact serialized System One request per PR and file, then return the same saved probabilities and compare rule IDs and tiers.
